summary: Full E2E testing of merged period-swap, teacher-bulk-actions, and late-absent-teacher features on the substitution subsystem. Backend pytest suite (6 tests) passes 100%. Frontend Playwright test verified: login, sub-nav-swap link, swap page schedule grid rendering (8 periods, teaching cells clickable), candidate list (25 shown after picking teacher A period), teachers page bulk toolbar with select-all + bulk activate/deactivate (status text toggled نشط ↔ غير نشط) + bulk delete confirm dialog cancelled non-destructively, and late-absent-teacher badge appears correctly on chip (data-testid sub-absent-late-<id>) when a new absent teacher is added AFTER an initial distribution.

React Router v7 future-flag warnings still logged (v7_startTransition / v7_relativeSplatPath) — cosmetic only, no functional impact.
Login form: submit succeeds even without remember-me checkbox; behaves as expected.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing 49 seeded teachers. Bulk operations on 2 real teachers were toggled and restored to نشط. No destructive changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 merged features (period swap, teachers bulk actions, late-absent badge) work end-to-end. Backend test file test_substitution_swap_bulk_late.py is a good regression suite. Frontend testids follow sub-swap-*, sub-bulk-*, sub-absent-late-* patterns. Swap teacher-A grid uses data-testid sub-swap-cell-a-{period} where cells with class 'pick' are teaching periods. Test date used: 2026-01-19 (Monday).
